failure_summary.description: Both trajectories omitted assigning and saving the search result to cache.
An explicit return date was encoded as an arrival date instead of a separate reverse-direction flight search.
A state abbreviation was passed as the attraction city rather than as the state.

patch.reasoning: The skill already explicitly requires saving every search result, modeling round trips as separate reverse-direction legs, and mapping state abbreviations to the state field. These failures reflect noncompliance with existing instructions rather than an uncovered skill gap, so no edit is warranted.
